photos.c:
Back Cover.
Youth John Gladwin, one of our talented younger members who this year has clocked 52.0 for 400 metres and 2:01.3 for 800 metres.
Inside Back Page: Winning Surrey Relay Youths Team. L to R, John Searle, Mark Sinclair, Dave North, Mark Waller, John Gladwin.
John Gladwin wearing lucky 13 on his way to victory in the Surrey Youths 800m.
Left. John Gladwin leads eventual winner Dave North in the Surrey Youths Cross Country Championship.
Belgrave's Youths Team in the Surrey C.C.Championships. L.to R. Dave North, Gerry Sexton, Mark Waller, John Gladwin and Alister Horton.
John Gladwin on his way to winning the Club 800m Championship in 1:50.8. Later he was to break the U.K. Youth record with 1:48.7.
Top Right.John Gladwin came 2nd in the Surrey Junior C.C. and won the Club 7½ miles Championships.
Bottom Right. Despite a serious leg injury John keeps fit in the only way possible.

John Gladwin sits in on Pete Brown(TVH) & John Walker in the Southern Counties Senior 800m Champs where he gained Silver. Stu Paton ducked under 1.50 for the first time in this race and is lurking in the pack.
NEW UK JUNIOR 4x1MILE RECORD HOLDERS. IN 17.23.2 (Ave. 4.20.8) L.to R. John Gladwin,Stuart Paton,Paul Richley, and Mark Waller.
Top. John Gladwin, who managed to reach a peak to finish 12th in the National C.C. Championships and just failed to make the England team for Gateshead.
Some of the gang in the Boxing Day Fancy Dress Handicap. Top.L to R. Paul Richley, John Gladwin ,Alan Painter & Tony Grant. Centre. Bill Couzens, Bottom Leo Coy, Simon Pritchard and Peter Staples.

FRONT COVER. John Gladwin's summer has included a fine win in the U.K 1500m Championship. Here we see John with Seb Coe representing the U.K in June's Russia match. In windy conditions and after setting the early pace John outkicked Olympic 1500m bronze medallist Kirov(4) for second.

West side story. 1 mile into the 5¾ and the field is bunched waiting for the break. Following Mark Sinclair and John Gladwin are Bob Lettin(71), Leo Coy, Olly Foote, Laurie O'Hara, Mike Nouch,Eric Crutcher(70),Martin Lake,Simon Williamson(68),and Keith Sinclair(22).

Our victorious team after their outstanding win in the Wellington Relays held on the race course at Ostend.
Back row left to right; Mike Alleyne, Derrick Williams, Guy Sagar, Pat Lyttle, Dave Mote, Gary Staines, John Gladwin, Kevin Sturman, Richard Addison, and Mark Sinclair.
Front row left to right; Paul Richley, Stuart Paton, Oliver Foote, and Team Manager - Leo Coy.
John Gladwin anchored our 'A' team middle distance men to a fine win in the Cannon Zatopek City of London inaugural 6 stage relay.

Back Cover.   The South of Thames Junior C.C.Championship provided a unique and exciting spectacle for Belgrave supporters when at the 2 mile mark our men held the first 4 places in the 300 strong field. Our picture shows eventual winner Oliver Foote in the lead from Mark Sinclair(6th), John Gladwin(2nd), and Dave North(7th), the team's winning score being the best ever recorded in the 50 year history of this race - a fitting result with Gordon Biscoe as the S.O.T. President.

Following a remarkable season including winning the AAA's 1500m title, second in the Commonwealth 1500m and new club mile record John Gladwin beat a class field including John Walker, Jack Buckner, Tim Hutchins and Dave Moorcroft to win the London Mile in record time.

BELGRAVE CENTENARY X/C RACE 17.1.87 (Photos by Mark Shearman)
Above — John Gladwin finishing 7th. First man home for Belgrave

On page to Right Top The Start P.Eales(39) and R.Treadwell(43) to the fore for Surrey closely followed by R.Nerurker(21) and S.Fielding(20) for (E.C.C.U) and Belgravians J.Wright(18),J.Gladwin(10), J.Chaston(5),G.Tiernan(16),F.Ward(17) and M.Chaston(6).

The Belgrave Boys pose before the Winter's first Surrey League match at Wimbledon. Standing, left to right: Michael Manning and daughter, Ray Foley, Mick Graham, 'Gerry' Adams, John Mather, Rob Harding,Paul Roche, Junior Galley, a yawning John Gladwin who's seen it all before, Stu' Paton, Pete Gilbey, Tony Binda, Colin Preston, Roger Alsop, Charlie Dickinson, Marlon Anderson, Bruce Barton, Jesper Madsen, Alex Luce, Rex Bale, Steve Willimont, Tony Stone, Alan Mead, John Wasbrough. Kneeling: ?, Jim Estall, Markand Patel, Paul Graham, Peter McDonald, ?, Kevin Quinn, Amir Becirhodzic, Bernard Asante, Stephen 'Maggot' Quinn, John Wilson, Adam Jones.
